Professional profile

A career built across legal practice, public institutions, and social development.

Arjun Adhikari is a Nepal Bar Council–licensed advocate with a professional record spanning court work, legal consultancy, institutional service, mediation training, and earlier field research.

Since Marga 2072 B.S., he has been associated with Legal Heart Pvt. Ltd. as a promoter, with legal practice involving the Supreme Court, appellate courts, district courts, and related forums.

His LL.M. focused on Human Rights and Gender Justice. Earlier roles with the Supreme Court, law firms, Women Foundation of Nepal, and development projects contribute a broad understanding of legal and institutional contexts.

Available for enquiries inNepali · English · Hindi
